errors.text_span: Die rechte Darstellung ist ein Liniendiagramm, das die gleichen Daten in Form von Linien für jede der vier Kategorien (Bund, Länder, Gemeinden, Gesamtheit der Gebietskörperschaften) zeigt.
errors.evidence: The right-hand chart is not a line diagram but another stacked bar chart, structurally similar to the left-hand one. It does not show separate lines for the categories "Bund", "Länder", and "Gemeinden"; it shows stacked bars for these and a single black line for the total.

The prompt asks to report representative values from the highest and lowest bars or to note trends using exact data. The description does not provide any specific numerical values from the chart, such as the peak of total investment in the left chart in 1991 (approx. 3.2% of GDP).

errors.text_span: Keine der Balken oder Linien ist visuell hervorgehoben.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. Both charts feature a vertical dashed line with an annotation ("Bahnreform²"), which is a form of visual highlighting to mark a specific event in time. The description mentions this annotation earlier, making this sentence contradictory.

errors.text_span: Ein vertikaler gestrichelter Pfeil und die Beschriftung „Bahnreform“ weisen auf das Jahr 2000 hin.
errors.evidence: The dashed vertical line is placed just before the year 2000 tick mark, indicating an event that happened before 2000 (e.g., in 1999). Stating that it points to the year 2000 is slightly inaccurate.
